cards.subject: estrogen
cards.heading: Hormonal Weight Gain
title: How
Estrogen
Imbalance Drives Weight Gain
cards.alt: When estrogen is imbalanced fat storage rises, muscle mass falls, metabolism slows and water retention increases

items.label: Muscle mass falls
items.note: Which lowers what you burn at rest

items.label: Water retention
items.note: Adding to the number on the scale

cards.subject: hypothyroidism
cards.heading: How Hypothyroidism Can Lead to Weight Gain
title: How
Hypothyroidism
Adds Weight
cards.alt: Hypothyroidism adds weight through a slowed metabolism, fluid retention, and the fatigue that reduces daily movement

items.label: Slower metabolism
items.note: Fewer calories burned, even at rest

items.label: Glutathione
items.note: Antioxidant for detox and brighter skin

cards.subject: Lipo-B
cards.heading: What Are Lipo-B (MIC) Injections, Really?
title: What Is in a
Lipo-B
(MIC) Injection
cards.alt: A Lipo-B MIC injection holds methionine, inositol and choline, usually with B vitamins including B12

items.label: Methionine
items.note: Amino acid in methylation and fat metabolism

items.label: Choline
items.note: Helps the liver package and move fats

items.label: B vitamins
items.note: Usually B12, for energy and nerve function

items.note: Red blood cells and mental clarity

cards.subject: NAD+

NAD+
